items.title: Postgres knowledge store
items.content: PostgreSQL can keep relational notes, full-text search, and pgvector embeddings together. HNSW indexes make approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval practical without a separate vector database.

items.title: Reciprocal rank fusion
items.content: Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines independent ranked lists. It helps exact keyword matches and semantic vector results complement one another in hybrid search.

items.title: Reliable background jobs
items.content: A PostgreSQL worker can claim queued jobs with SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, then retry failures with exponential backoff and idempotent processing.

items.title: Local-first privacy
items.content: Local-first software keeps personal knowledge on infrastructure the user controls. Local embeddings and an optional self-hosted Ollama server avoid sending private notes to a hosted model.
